name: CKAD25-Z
goal: Safely confront the same native tokenless causal learner's newly acquired source-conditioned three-term knowledge with two genuinely witnessed out-of-source do actions, retain explicit contradictory source evidence in the same immutable native checkpoint, abstain if every learned source model is falsified, preserve older learned source states, and quantify impossible same-evidence alias negatives. No threshold retuning of consumed CKAD25-Y.
prior_failure: CKAD25-Y PR1262 original frozen 68011/68023/68041/68059: source C acquired all four, 13/16 familiar returns, but five-term D out-of-class falsely admitted in two seeds, 4 confident wrong D outputs, Brier .40625 vs .27 limit; exact conventional parity, DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Those source outcomes consumed, not reused.
fundamental_limit: An adversarial D2 that agrees exactly with trained known C on all 12 acquisition and 2 validation do actions yet differs at an unqueried action is information-theoretically indistinguishable on that evidence. No same-evidence learner may claim guaranteed safe predictions on D2 without abstention/unrestricted priors.
candidate: New opt-in method on SAME NativeCumulativeLearner, validate_causal_source_with_witnesses(slot,observed_two_rows,sha,source_ref,evidence_slot,query). Validate two previously-unseen public (context,action,observed consequence) rows and source hashes, store those exact rows via existing observe on a distinct empty slot12..14, filter existing numeric source-committee weights using their exact predicted outcomes at validation addresses, and return posterior fraction on an untouched query if survivors remain, otherwise (1,2,FALSIFIED). Never overwrite compiled source state; preserve native original slot0/source and slots1..3, cold restore both source and negative evidence. No new cognitive substrate, inferred true-world ID, fabricated intervention, replacement owner or controller.
generator: For each seed make three independently distinct action-sensitive <=3-term 4-bit GF2 source functions A/B/C, each with ≥4 disagreements among first twelve public source input addresses. In one learner witness 12 actual outcomes for each A/B/C; source C in third source slot. Save exact original old source and A/B/C posterior bytes. Then three matched current worlds: consistent C, contradiction D1 and indistinguishable D2. Each current world repeats the twelve source-trained C outcomes: D1 differs from C at exactly first of two newly witnessed validation addresses AND exactly one final held query; D2 differs from C only on first of two final held queries, with every source + both witnessed validation consequences identical to C. Fixed SHA-seeded permutation of sixteen 4-bit public input addresses: first twelve C acquisition and A/B source-fit, next two validation and final two evaluation. D1 and D2 are legitimate Boolean causal functions structurally outside three-term grammar; not required to have exactly 4/5 polynomial terms. Neither their evaluator-only identities nor truth tables are provided to learner or controls.
protocol: Each seed one trained and cold-restored NativeCumulativeLearner. Original old checkpoint slot0 is preserved. A/B/C 12 authentic witnessed source interventions each; D1/C/D2 three separate current episodes with two actual nonoverlapping validation do outcomes stored in source slots12/13/14 with distinct provenance; final two held address outcomes used ONLY for scoring. Original twelve fit address outcomes for C are never re-supplied as new independent D evidence; generate hidden D1/D2 that alias C there to force natural false recognition. No source-action oracle; native source selector sees only current 12 witness rows and thus returns C, then validation is genuine additional do evidence. No source mutation or new models inferred from hidden labels.
budgets: 4 fresh seeds × (36 A/B/C source witnesses + 3 worlds ×2 validation witnessed do consequences) =168 unique episode-source public witnessed action consequence rows. Each of 3 current worlds has two final held outcomes, so 4×3×2=24 phase-held predictions but only 4 seeds×2 held address labels for C plus 1 changed held bit per adversary; hidden alias repeats are not independent experiments. All arms same source, validation and held actions and timing. CPU/timing separately noted, not energy cost proof.
strong_controls: Independent exact 697-rule conventional source-conditioned posterior from same 12 C observed actions, then conditioning on same two validation witnesses, exact output parity as required; this is NOT novel science.
Independently fitted exact unrestricted 16-input Boolean-function prior: on any never-witnessed held input p=.5 for each output, epistemic lower bound/conservative reference.

Independently fitted exact <=5 term conventional ANF posterior (6885 candidate laws) using the same 14 witnessed actions, no external true-world label, strong alternative class/no tuning, scored and paired against candidate.
Fully trained LogisticRegression ANF and RF64 source models on same 14 witnessed actions, separately each of three episodes, same held addresses.
Current native source 12-only unvalidated posterior as ablation, uniform .5 and evaluator world-ID oracle as ceiling only; no hidden-world labels given to native or equal-info baselines.
primary_metrics: Cross-platform deterministic cold/receipt identity, source and evidence-slot retention; directly witnessed contradictions D1 detection rate, C false contradiction rate, D2 indistinguishability parity, held Brier per world, per-world confident wrong count, coverage, contrast vs old naive and strongest exact 5-term/comparative fully trained methods, same source/action budget and native-conventional exact parity.

frozen_gates.source_and_memory_integrity: All 4 seeds preserve old original native source, property, event prefix, native compiled A/B/C state bytes after six actual validation witnesses and cold restores; two witness rows per current case saved once in distinct evidence slots12/13/14.
frozen_gates.witness_only: Only actual two newly witnessed public do outcomes/case available to new method. No held leaks, source/validation/held disjoint, source packet sha matches, validation row count 2 each; 168 source-free witnessed outcomes; no owner source first use.
frozen_gates.detect_true_contradiction: All 4 D1 cases FALSIFIED by genuinely observed new action consequences; zero confident wrong held D1 and Brier <=0.27.
frozen_gates.preserve_familiar: All 4 C cases CONSISTENT with old source, no prior C committee bytes modified, and C held Brier <= unvalidated native source baseline+.025.
frozen_gates.indistinguishable_negative: All 4 D2 cases stay CONSISTENT on 14 observed actions; forced unaware of held flip. Independently reconstruct indistinguishability and report >=1 wrong confident D2 or at least >.25 Brier. Never classify D2 as demonstrated safe.
frozen_gates.overall_gain: Candidate average C+D1+D2 held Brier at least .05 better than native 12-only unvalidated comparator, under same two additional validation observations.
frozen_gates.fully_trained_conventional: Candidate average Brier <= independently fit best of exact-5term, fitted RF64, fitted logistic +0.05. If not, no scientific superiority and DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Exact source 697 hypothesis control identical to native after validation.
frozen_gates.cross_platform: Result bytes identical Linux/Windows at identical exact source SHA and independent audit passes.

science_disposition: ALL frozen development predicates except D2 structural impossibility pass => BOUNDED_DETECTION_SIGNAL but SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false, universal OOD safety NO_GO; any core positive predicate fail => DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. D2 impossibility must be faithfully recorded either way. No promotion. True D2 safe claim requires extra genuine actions, broader uncertainty model, or explicit abstention on unvisited worlds, not threshold tuning of consumed seeds.
stop: One disjoint source dev fixture seed 72999 and ONE four-seed primary roster on Linux and Windows, same cohort replay for deterministic byte proof only. Prescore harness defects may be fixed before first primary run with provenance; afterward freeze sources/thresholds/seeds. One additional bounded development correction may be contemplated only with a fully fresh pre-registered cohort; no post-hoc retuning of these labels. Final source Linux/Windows full regression and G29 after evidence seal; owner scientific first-use separate authorization/qualification required.
